src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The 2 and 6 define perpendicular axes; their intersection is the center.
    two=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==2)
    six=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==6)
    r,c=six
    # draw 2 horizontal bar centered at 6's column
    for dc,v in [(-2,2),(-1,5),(0,4),(1,5),(2,2)]:
        if 0<=c+dc<len(g[0]): g[r][c+dc]=v
    # vertical 6 bar centered around horizontal axis row
    for dr,v in [(-5,6),(-4,5),(-3,5),(-2,5),(-1,5),(0,4),(1,6)]:
        if 0<=r+dr<len(g):
            if g[r+dr][c]==0:g[r+dr][c]=v
    # diagonal ray of 4 from the crossing, down-left and up-right
    for d in range(1,max(len(g),len(g[0]))):
        for rr,cc in [(r+d,c-d),(r-d,c+d)]:
            if 0<=rr<len(g) and 0<=cc<len(g[0]) and g[rr][cc]==0:g[rr][cc]=4
    return g
'''
open(base+'/task-64971f31.py','w').write(src)
